tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground behind lists, the editor and settings. Discothèque role: paper.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, panels, dialogs, the top bar and the sidebar. Discothèque role: paper-raised.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Board columns, progress tracks, code wells in light, skeleton base, the Draft badge. Discothèque role: paper-sunk.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, nav items and menu options; empty translation cells. Discothèque role: paper-tint.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Inside inputs, selects and the rich-text editor.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px hairline around cards, tables, panels and between rows. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control. Discothèque role: rule.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: 1px outline of inputs, switches, checkboxes and secondary buttons: ≥3:1 on surface, field, canvas and surface-sunk in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas, surface, surface-sunk, surface-hover and field (≥13:1 in both themes). Discothèque role: ink.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, field labels' hints, counts. ≥6:1 on canvas, surface and surface-sunk in both themes.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, timestamps in dense rows, disabled labels. ≥4.5:1 on canvas, surface and surface-sunk; never the only copy of an instruction.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Toasts, tooltips and the offline banner: the one dark-on-light (or light-on-dark) object. Discothèque role: chocolate.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on inverse (≥13:1).

tokens.name: on-inverse-accent
tokens.usage: The action word in a toast (Undo, View): ≥5:1 on inverse in both themes.

tokens.name: code
tokens.usage: Code wells: blocks of code, terminals, requests and answers. Dark in both themes. Discothèque role: code.

tokens.name: code-text
tokens.usage: Code and plain text in a code well (≥13:1).

tokens.name: code-text-muted
tokens.usage: Comments, punctuation, line numbers and labels in a code well.

tokens.name: code-border
tokens.usage: Lines between rows and panes inside a code well. Decorative only.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords, keys and the line being pointed at in a code well.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Strings and values in a code well.

tokens.name: code-function
tokens.usage: Function names, numbers and constants in a code well.

tokens.name: code-focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring on controls inside a code well: the dark theme's focus, since the well is dark in both. Discothèque role: code-focus.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand colour: primary buttons, the selected tab's underline, checked switches and checkboxes, progress, the focus ring. Discothèque role: action (and mustard for selection).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and press.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover (≥5.7:1 light, ≥7:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, selected row, the active segment, highlighted search match, a field that just changed. Discothèque role: mustard as a selection fill.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, the selected nav item's text, and text on accent-soft (≥5.5:1 on surface, canvas and accent-soft).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: text and icons on surface, canvas and danger-soft; danger button fill. Discothèque role: rust.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of blocking problems, Changes-asked badges and deleted text in diffs. Discothèque role: rust-soft.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Live badge fill, Approve buttons, done ticks; text on surface, canvas and success-soft.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on a success fill.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Approved badges, inserted text in diffs, 'all caught up' notices.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons: suggestions, counters near a limit, In-review badge text. Text on surface, canvas and warning-soft. Discothèque role: warning-ink.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: In-review and unpublished-edits badges, suggestion rows, freshly added rows. Discothèque role: mustard-soft.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Scheduled state and informational notes: text and icons on surface, canvas and info-soft. Discothèque role: teal.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Scheduled badges and info notes. Discothèque role: teal-soft.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element: ≥4.5:1 on canvas, surface and field in both themes.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Dimmed backdrop behind dialogs and the command palette.

tokens.name: presence-1
tokens.usage: First person on a screen: avatar, field tab, caret. Text on it: on-presence.

tokens.name: presence-2
tokens.usage: Second person. Text on it: on-presence.

tokens.name: presence-3
tokens.usage: Third person. Text on it: on-presence.

tokens.name: presence-4
tokens.usage: Fourth person. Text on it: on-presence.

tokens.name: presence-5
tokens.usage: Fifth person. Text on it: on-presence.

tokens.name: presence-6
tokens.usage: Sixth person; never a status. Text on it: on-presence.

tokens.name: on-presence
tokens.usage: Initials and name-tab text on any presence colour (≥4.5:1 on all six in both themes).

tokens.name: type-article
tokens.usage: Type square for articles in link chips and search results. Letter on it: on-presence.

tokens.name: type-event
tokens.usage: Type square for events.

tokens.name: type-media
tokens.usage: Type square for media.

tokens.name: type-person
tokens.usage: Type square for people.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The overview greeting and a dashboard's big numbers. One per screen.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: List and settings page titles; the entry title in the editor header.

styles.name: entry-title
styles.usage: The entry's title field in the editor, so the content reads larger than the chrome.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Card, panel, dialog and form-section headings.

styles.name: item
styles.usage: Entry names in rows and cards, column heads.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Le 14 mars 1976, à 4 h 12, le HORIZON-E a quitté la surface.
styles.usage: Rich-text editing and previews, at most 72 characters per line.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Two articles wait for your review.
styles.usage: Default UI text, inputs, table cells.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names, button labels, emphasis in rows.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata, help text under fields, badges.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, in sentence case, in text.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Sidebar group headings and table group rows only, uppercase, in text-muted.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Keyboard hints, in a 1px border-strong box.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button groups, chip gaps, label to input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, gaps inside cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, phone gutter, between fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter, between form sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Main content padding on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between major page regions.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Badges, kbd boxes, chips, checkboxes, thumbnails in rows.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented controls, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, panels, board columns, media cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, drawers' inner corner, the command palette.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Avatars, switches and the presence dot only.

shadow.note: Folio separates objects with 1px borders first; shadows are soft, low and reserved for things that float above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-s
tokens.usage: Cards in a dashboard and hovered media cards. Lists and tables use border only.

tokens.name: shadow-m
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, link previews, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-l
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the command palette, drawers.

tokens.name: shadow-drag
tokens.usage: Anything being dragged.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: Every border: cards, inputs, tables, buttons.

tokens.name: border-selected
tokens.usage: Selected media card, the active tab's underline, the presence ring on a field.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, drawn with focus at 2px offset.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hovers, presses, toggles.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts appearing.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Drawers, dialogs, list items moving.

tokens.name: duration-ambient
tokens.usage: Presence arriving, live updates from others, highlight fades.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Things entering or moving. No overshoot anywhere in Folio.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving.

tokens.name: pop
tokens.usage: Things you caused appearing. Lands without bouncing.

tokens.name: settle
tokens.usage: Things landing after a move. Quick, no bounce.

tokens.name: pen
tokens.usage: Folio's flourish: ink that draws itself (ticks, edge lines, rings, the seal).
